purpose: Prospective confirmatory visible-form/mixed-scene engineering diagnostic, never material, identity, hazard or sorting truth.
limitations: AI visual review of all29 downloaded candidates before predictions; independent human review remains required and pretraining membership is unknown. Public catalogue and selected outdoor/still-life photographs are not representative real-camera samples. Final20 references contain ten visible-form positives, five mixed supported-kind scenes and five outside-kind controls; the historical tonic bottle-and-box is an explicit domain limitation. Reusable containers, partial tote straps and saucers are disclosed context challenges, never packaging, composition, hazard or sorting truth. All earlier acquired, evaluated, rejected and reserved source/hash groups are excluded, including all48 robustness candidates; the Meanwell Packaging stock-photo series is excluded as a conservative source-family precaution. No model results were used to select or replace images.

excluded.reason: Unused reserve selected before predictions: bottle plus separate preform/comparison scene is less exclusive than the two simpler complete bottle references.
Eligibility exclusion: overhead food and jar-rim close-up lacks the whole jar body and base; filename is not whole-form evidence.
Eligibility exclusion: unfolded carton net or sheet with clipped edges, not a clear whole three-dimensional box.
Eligibility exclusion: flat textile and strap crop lacks sufficiently clear whole-bag form and would rely excessively on the source title.
Unused reserve selected before predictions: complete bag form is valid, but the historical museum/reusable-object context is less relevant than the contemporary pouch and tote references.
Unused reserve selected before predictions: whole dual-handle mug is valid but ordinary handled mug and teacup references were selected for this finite budget.
Eligibility exclusion: bag is visible but the alleged bottle is heavily obscured by vegetation and cannot establish a clear two-supported-kind reference without trusting the title.
Privacy exclusion: bottles and cups are visible but people and body parts occupy the stage scene. No-person candidates are preferred; public copyright permission does not supply privacy clearance.
Privacy exclusion: a mixed litter scene includes several people/body parts. Do not treat a public licence as clearance to reuse them for this diagnostic.
